skill.name: ai-music
skill.description: Generate and edit AI music with the RunComfy CLI. The skill selects ElevenLabs or ACE Step routes for vocals, instrumentals, inpaint, and outpaint tasks.
skill.summary: Route music generation and audio edits through RunComfy models with task-specific prompts.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: The static shell, network, filesystem, and blocker hits are primarily Markdown documentation false positives. However, the skill contains a supply-chain risk because the install command points to a different repository than the audited source. Publication should wait until the install source is aligned with the audited repository.

remediation.issue: Install command redirects to a different repository.
remediation.suggestion: Update the install command to the audited doany-ai/skills source, or remove it until that source is verified.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on a paid external CLI workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running RunComfy jobs, and show expected duration, cost, and output location.

remediation.issue: Token storage is mentioned in skill documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the disclosure, and add that agents must never read or display the local token file.

content.value_statement: Creating usable music prompts across different AI models takes time and model knowledge. This skill chooses a RunComfy music route and prepares model-specific guidance for generation or edits.
actual_capabilities: Selects ElevenLabs Music for polished vocal tracks and commercial-style prompts.
Selects ACE Step or ACE Step 1.5 for lower-cost drafts, lyrics, and multilingual vocals.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation patterns for text-to-music generation.
Guides ACE Step audio inpaint requests with start and end time ranges.
Guides ACE Step audio outpaint requests to extend an existing track before or after.
Explains model tradeoffs for cost, duration, vocals, language support, and edit type.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Generated music quality depends on the selected model and prompt detail.
Audio edit routes require a user-provided source audio URL.
The skill does not verify music rights, lyrics ownership, or commercial licensing terms.

use_cases.title: Draft a Brand Jingle
use_cases.description: Create a short prompt for a polished vocal or instrumental jingle using the premium route.

use_cases.title: Build Background Music Sets
use_cases.description: Generate many low-cost instrumental drafts with varied tags for videos, games, or podcasts.

use_cases.title: Repair or Extend a Track
use_cases.description: Use inpaint or outpaint guidance to replace a weak section or add a longer ending.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 60 second instrumental background track for a calm product demo. Prefer a low-cost RunComfy model.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Vocal Song Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with style and lyrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Make a 90 second indie pop song draft with female vocals, clear verse and chorus sections, and a hopeful tone.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs budget and quality tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best RunComfy route for three 30 second ad jingles, then provide prompts for a cheap draft and a premium final.

prompt_templates.title: Edit Existing Audio
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using inpaint or outpaint.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a 30 second hook URL. Extend it into a two minute track and replace the middle section with a softer bridge.

output_examples.input: Generate a calm 60 second instrumental for a software walkthrough.
output_examples.output: The skill would choose ACE Step for a low-cost instrumental draft and describe tags for tempo, mood, instruments, and duration.

output_examples.input: Create a premium 15 second sung brand jingle with a bright chorus.
output_examples.output: The skill would choose ElevenLabs Music and provide a concise prompt with style, section labels, lyric direction, and target length.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30 second audio clip with a new intro and outro.
output_examples.output: The skill would choose ACE Step audio outpaint and ask for the source audio URL, extension lengths, and style tags.

best_practices: State the target length, vocal style, mood, instruments, language, and intended use.
Use short draft generations before spending more on premium or longer outputs.
Confirm rights for lyrics and source audio before generating or editing music.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private API tokens, account details, or unreleased lyrics into prompts.
Do not use copyrighted lyrics or recordings without permission from the rights holder.
Do not request vague music like good song without genre, mood, duration, or use case.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate songs, instrumentals, jingles, loops, and edited audio through RunComfy music models.

faq.question: Which models does it route to?
faq.answer: It routes to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, ACE Step audio inpaint, and ACE Step audio outpaint.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI needs authentication before it can submit model runs and download generated audio.

faq.question: Can it create music with lyrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports lyric-focused prompts and section markers when the selected model supports vocals.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing track?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step inpaint can replace a time range, and outpaint can extend the track before or after.

faq.question: Does it handle music licensing?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm rights for source audio, lyrics, and any commercial use of generated outputs.
